verdict.rationale: The SDK is an open-source Python/JS library you run yourself via the `Runner` class, is explicitly 'provider-agnostic, supporting... 100+ other LLMs', and lets you globally disable OpenAI's tracing telemetry via an env var, indicating agents can run without dependence on OpenAI's hosted platform. However, some features (WebSearchTool, FileSearchTool, CodeInterpreterTool, hosted MCP, default tracing dashboard) are OpenAI-managed unless explicitly swapped out or disabled, so true zero-vendor-dependency requires active configuration choices. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of a fully self-hosted deployment with non-OpenAI models and tracing disabled, and explicit vendor documentation framing this as a supported 'self-hosted' deployment mode.
